main_text.p: Syr.Idem. Aphel אַחְמִית Excandescere facere, Offendere, Ad iram provocare, Prov.20.2.
חֵימָת Ch. Uter, lagena. Esth.7.10. in Targ. sec. Hebr. חֵמָת. Vide etiam in יחם.
חִנַּג Pahel Ch. Tripudiare, Saltare, Exo.15.20. &32. 19.in T.Jon. Convenit cum חגג.
חִנָּנָא Ch. Tibia, Fistula, Cithara: Item Chorus. Plur. חִנָּנַיָא, חִנָּנִין.
חַנָּה Hebr. Castrametari : Hospitari, Diversari. Hinc
חַנָּוָא, חַנְוָא Ch.& Syr. Taberna, Officina. Plur. חַנְוָוָן Act.28.15. emph. חַנְוָתָא Jerem.37.16. cum aff. חַנְוָתִיךְ, Ezech.27.27.& חַנְוָתִיךְ ibid.v.17.quod melius legeretur חַנְוָתִיךְ.
חַנַּט Chald. Aromatibus condire, Balsamare, Gen. 50.3. יוֹמֵי חַנִּיטָיָא Dies Aromatibus conditorum, Ibidem. Hebr. חַנָּטִים.
Syr. Conditura, condimentum, Mistura aromatica, Joh.19.39.
חִטָּה Heb. Syr. Triticum, frumentum, Marc. 4.28. Joh.12.24. Plur.Ch. חִטִּין, & חִנָּטִין, Syr. Tritica.
חָנַךְ Ch. Initiavit, dedicavit: Item Instruere, Assuefacere. Unde, כַּר הַוָּא מְחַנַּךְ פּוּמֵיהּ Cùm assuefaceret os suum, Deut.32.3. in Jon.& T.Hier.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the vowel points and some Syriac forms are uncertain and may differ in detail. The catchword-like final "חנן" at the foot right is a catchword in Hebrew letters.
